decision_rule: manifest fail_rule: no arm meets the pass rule by the cap. Applied at 3 of 4 under the fail-fast rule (Hartshorne p034/p179): the one remaining evaluation has a registered additive prediction that fails every registered band, so spending it cannot change the decision.
decision_text: SP3 (E gain split) closes as FAIL with three of four evaluations spent. Evaluation 1 (g0-b3) reproduced B3 at 250/310 pA, measured the low-drive excess (4 spikes at 200 pA against the exact repeat band of 1) and met its own rejection clause on the sweep-43 late return (+1.4 to +1.7 mV). Evaluation 2 (g1-ih-half) removed no spike at 250 pA. Evaluation 3 (g2-leak-150) silenced 250 pA and moved the sweep-43 return -3.8 mV. Evaluation 4 (combined Ih half + leak x1.5) is registered and not spent because its additive prediction fails every registered band. The E cell stays at frozen B3, unpromoted.

REJECTED on the registered clause: 250 pA count still 8 (band 5-7); rest -1.73 mV, 310 pA rate -0.23 Hz, sweep-43 return -0.7 mV; the lever moved the rest, not the gain. Sweep 56 not run.

arms.verdict: REJECTED on the sweep-43 return (moved -3.06 to -3.78 mV, past the donor) and the 310 pA count (6 < 8); counts 0/0/6 at 200/250/310 pA, 250 pA plateau -66.8 mV; pure-shift clause not met (drops -8 and -4), so the leak rotates the curve by silencing 250 pA, not by landing it.

arms.reason_not_spent: The additive reading of evaluations 2 and 3 predicts rest about -2.7 mV below B3, 250 pA plateau below -67 mV (count 0 at 200 and 250 pA), 310 pA count <= 6 with rate below 6.0 Hz, and a sweep-43 late return about -4.5 mV from g0-b3: every registered Stage G band fails. The registered linear dose rule also yields no admissible dose (leak_factor 1.1875: 310 rate change -1.51 Hz against 1.5, sweep-43 move -1.15 to -1.42 mV against 1). Under the fail-fast rule an evaluation whose registered prediction is a FAIL on every band cannot change the campaign decision and is not spent.

sk_ca_set_late_rate_at_310.statement: Somatic SK (0.35) with calcium decay 1.0 is sufficient, on this geometry with the axonal initiation site, to set the late inter-spike interval at 310 pA to the donor's (10 spikes, 10.05 vs 10.00 Hz, cycles 4-10 within 110-124 ms), and this setting is insensitive to the Ih density (9.82 Hz at Ih half). It is not sufficient for the low-drive count: the same dose leaves 8 spikes at 250 pA and 4 at 200 pA.
sk_ca_set_late_rate_at_310.mechanism: SK is a calcium-activated potassium current whose magnitude follows the per-spike calcium entry; it translates the whole f-I curve (the same interval correction at every input) and cannot rotate it.

ih_density_does_not_set_low_drive_count.statement: Halving the uniform distributed Ih density (9.99e-5 to about 5.0e-5 S/cm2) is not sufficient to remove any spike at 250 pA (8 -> 8) and shortens no late cycle by more than 6 ms; it moves the rest -1.73 mV and the sweep-43 late return -0.7 mV.
ih_density_does_not_set_low_drive_count.mechanism: At this density Ih is a standing depolarising conductance near rest: it offsets the resting potential and the post-pulse return, and its contribution between spikes at 250 pA is not the current that carries the three excess spikes.

leak_sets_rheobase_as_step_not_slope.statement: Scaling g_pas by 1.5 raises rheobase above 250 pA (count 8 -> 0, soma plateau -66.8 mV, about 10 mV under threshold) and takes 310 pA from 10 to 6; the count at 250 pA is a step in the leak, not a line, so no leak dose lands it at 5 while the 310 pA rate stays within 1.5 Hz. The same lever moves the sweep-43 return -3.8 mV per 0.5 factor, past the donor.
leak_sets_rheobase_as_step_not_slope.mechanism: g_pas sets the input resistance; a fixed command moves the pulse plateau in proportion, and the count is a threshold crossing of that plateau. Because the plateau and the subthreshold return are the same passive quantity, the leak cannot hold F5 within 1 mV and land the low-drive count together.

unresolved_link: The current that removes three spikes at 200-250 pA while leaving the 310 pA train and the sweep-43 return fixed. Both passive levers move the f-I curve and F5 in a fixed ratio, so this current must be voltage- or use-dependent and is outside the fit's passive family.

reassessment.statement: The low-drive gain (4 spikes at 200 pA vs human 1; 8 vs 5 at 250 pA; correct at 310 pA) is set outside the fit's passive family.
